name: Enemy Posture System - POST05 selective reaction suppression, finalize (TEST)
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. POST05 0.5.3 (POST05-FINALIZE): everything of 0.5.2 (an ordinary non-lethal sword hit that lands while a Bokoblin is attacking and its posture stays below 100 no longer starts the DAMAGE flinch: the final setActionMode(DAMAGE) of damage_check is undone by restoring the three mode fields; Blue/E_OC in ATTACK 0/1/2, Red/Black E_OC2 in a mature B/C swing or ATTACK 0 braking). New: E_OC2 also keeps attacking on the swing start tick, the first clip frame and the clip end when Bokoblin Expansion cannot be loaded (its required EVF service is not published), and on the first clip frame when the Expansion rate is already decided (x1.15 owned, or a base Black). With Expansion possibly loaded, the start tick and a possibly pending x2 frame stay vanilla so its x1.15/x2 is never lost. The hit that reaches 100 and later hits stay vanilla (POST06 not implemented). One PRE+POST hook, PRE always continues. Replaces POST05 0.5.2/0.5.1/0.5.0: never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
